name: Work Visa (Presidential Decree 49/25)

requirements.blocker_text: Under Presidential Decree No. 49/25 of 18 February 2025 (which replaced Decree 49/17 of 2017) and the General Labor Law, a foreign worker needs a registered employment contract with an Angolan employer, who must file the contract with the employment authority within 30 days of the worker starting. A foreign-worker cap of 30% of a company's workforce applies (secondary source; no detailed labor-market-test procedure was found alongside it). A 5% contract-registration fee applies; other visa fees vary by case and were not itemized in the sources reached. As of March 2026, the process for the border-visa track for energy/oil/gas/mining-sector workers was simplified: applicants no longer need pre-approval from the Ministry of Mineral Resources, Petroleum and Gas (MIREMPET) before applying directly to SME, though this specific reform's effective date was not confirmed and the source noted border-visa applications were temporarily paused while the two agencies finalized the new system.
requirements.fix_path: Secure an employment contract with an employer that has not exceeded its 30% foreign-worker cap, then apply for the Work Visa; the employer must register the contract within 30 days of the worker's start date.

evidence_required.document: Medical certificate and criminal record check
Certified Portuguese translations of foreign documents

STATUS: DRAFT -- the primary decree text (Presidential Decree 49/25) could not be located and fetched directly in this build, so both the quota figure and the 2026 process reform rest on secondary sources. GENUINE, CURRENT FINDING, flagged rather than smoothed over: as of the article's reporting (March 2026, six months before this build), Angola's own transitional notice said Border Visa applications for the energy/mining sector were TEMPORARILY PAUSED while SME and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs finalized the simplified system -- meaning a foreign worker relying on this specific reform should not assume it is fully operational without checking current status. family_can_join set to false at this file's outcome level since family accompaniment runs through Angola's separate, distinct Visto de Permanência Temporária mechanism (see ao_family_reunification.json), not through this work visa directly. dual_citizenship_allowed set to false per Article 32 of the Nationality Law (Lei 2/16), which explicitly does not recognize any other nationality for Angolan citizens -- confirmed directly in ao_citizenship_naturalisation.json.
